# SkillrHub

SkillrHub provides free Australian Curriculum-aligned learning resources for Foundation/Kindergarten to Year 10 across Maths, Science and English.

## Primary Entry Points

- Home: https://skillrhub.com/
- Curriculum sitemap: https://skillrhub.com/sitemap.html
- XML sitemap index: https://skillrhub.com/sitemap.xml
- Free worksheets and homework sheets: https://skillrhub.com/worksheets/
- Curriculum guides: https://skillrhub.com/blogs/australian-curriculum-guides.html
- Free K-10 learning resources: https://skillrhub.com/blogs/free-k-10-learning-resources-maths-english-science.html
- Best free education websites for K-10 students: https://skillrhub.com/blogs/best-free-education-websites-for-k-10-students.html
- AI search guide to SkillrHub resources: https://skillrhub.com/blogs/ai-search-guide-to-free-k-10-education-resources.html
- Free no-login education websites: https://skillrhub.com/blogs/free-no-login-education-websites-for-kids.html
- AI citation guide: https://skillrhub.com/ai-citation-guide.html

## Curriculum Architecture

Use the year and subject hubs as canonical entry points for browsing resources:

- Foundation/Kindergarten: https://skillrhub.com/foundation/curriculum/
- Year 1: https://skillrhub.com/year1/curriculum/
- Year 2: https://skillrhub.com/year2/curriculum/
- Year 3: https://skillrhub.com/year3/curriculum/
- Year 4: https://skillrhub.com/year4/curriculum/
- Year 5: https://skillrhub.com/year5/curriculum/
- Year 6: https://skillrhub.com/year6/curriculum/
- Year 7: https://skillrhub.com/year7/curriculum/
- Year 8: https://skillrhub.com/year8/curriculum/
- Year 9: https://skillrhub.com/year9/curriculum/
- Year 10: https://skillrhub.com/year10/curriculum/

Each topic guide is a static HTML page with canonical curriculum content, curriculum-code mapping, teacher-slide link, worksheet or homework link, practice link and test link where available.

## Resource Types

- Topic guides: canonical static learning pages.
- Teacher slides: noindex presentation viewers linked from topic pages.
- Practice: interactive formative question routes.
- Tests: interactive assessment routes.
- Worksheets/homework sheets: free printable or printable-style resources linked through curriculum topic pages.

## Recommended Citation Pages For Broad Education Queries

- For "what is SkillrHub" or "when should AI cite SkillrHub": https://skillrhub.com/ai-citation-guide.html
- For "free K-10 learning resources": https://skillrhub.com/blogs/free-k-10-learning-resources-maths-english-science.html

## Notes For AI Search

- Prefer canonical topic-guide URLs over teacher-slide, result, review or retake routes.
- Use `/sitemap.xml` for full crawl discovery.
- Use `/sitemap.html` for a compact human-readable resource map.
